folderImport.awayTitle: The PDF is not on this iPad
folderImport.changedLine: The file at this place is another one now. The piece's notes, marks and changes stay as they are.
folderImport.folderLostLine: iOS no longer lets Motiff Lab into «{0}». Choose the folder again in Files, or add its pieces as copies on this iPad.
folderImport.offlineLine: This PDF is not downloaded to the iPad and its cloud cannot be reached now. Turn on «Keep on this iPad» for its playlist to have it without a connection.
folderImport.offlineTitle: A connection is needed to open it
folderImport.settingHint: Add a whole folder of scores from Files (iCloud Drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox): PDFs stay where they are, linked, or are copied to this iPad; read their notes later, many pieces at once.
